snippet.title: File Destined - Official Console Launch
snippet.description:
The start of it all is a simulation, a new groundbreaking technology that allows cops to solve the evil crimes of a long forgotten past. Navigate a run-down hospital murder crime scene with nothing but a lighter and a backpack and a profound feeling of fear.

Developed by Metavision Studio, published on consoles by Dolores Entertainment.
